sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You need to be very and practical and realistic in all that you do today, urges Ganesha. You are known to be pretty emotional and sensitive and generally go by your feelings. Your mind, your reason do not normally feature in you decision making. Even minor problems, complications get you worked up. Try to remain focused and down to earth this day. Sometimes you need to let your mind rule over your head. Follow your reasoning while taking decisions.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: This is the end of the first stage in your "socialization," Taurus. Are you satisfied with the people you've met? You can usually make the most out of these encounters, but did your political savvy let you down? Did it lead you in directions you didn't want to go? Take advantage of this pause to catch your breath and figure out where you are today and where you want to be tomorrow.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: A day of solitude will spark fresh inspiration, darling Taurus, as the Aries Moon carves out new pathways in the mind. Remember that the key to manifesting any vision is organization and hard work once Venus activates. Taking your goals seriously will help you feel more optimistic about the future as the nodes of fate stir. Stay close to home and back up your agenda with methodical action while Luna aligns with Jupiter, Chiron, and Mars tonight. Dramatic transformations will unfold throughout the coming weeks after the Sun debuts in Sagittarius, helping you find empowerment through sacrifice.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Take special care while sitting to avoid an injury. Further good posture not only enhances one's personality but also plays an important role in improving health and confidence. Due to a function being organized at home, you will have to spend a lot of money today. This can negatively affect your financial condition. You will have great time with friends but take extra care while driving. Getting stuck in someone’s company that you do not enjoy much might irritate you. So, choose wisely who you go out with.

readings.text: You may not work hard today and tend to depend completely on luck. However, achieving the desired results will be so important that you may even compromise on a few matters. You will coordinate with your peers on some important projects and ensure a smooth progress in the second half.

Your patience has paid off and finally you are reaping the rewards of the hard work you have been doing. Don't stop now! Today is a good day to plant the seeds for future success, but don't forget to stop and reward yourself for how far you've come.

bits.t: Even minor problems, complications get you worked up.
Remember that the key to manifesting any vision is organization and hard work once Venus activates.

readings.text: Professionals will have a better offer or two coming their way today, predicts Ganesha. If you are a businessman, you will have multiple deals coming your way. You may have to ask friends for help.

You may need more than ever to spend time focusing the lens on your goals. These aspects can create wonderful ideas or just downtime to ponder and woolgather. Future-oriented thoughts and ideas are featured as you think about how to take them to a wider and more profitable market. It will affect your house of travel, learning, teaching, publishing, spirituality, and the law. You're coming into your own one step at a time.

bits.t: Due to a function being organized at home, you will have to spend a lot of money today.
This can negatively affect your financial condition.

readings.text: Health looks fine but will improve more with routine exercise. You are likely to be in a relaxed mood today. The pending task needs to to be finished, try to focus more on the targets. In short, this seems to be a favorable day for you, feels Ganesha.

Spoken words that are unfair or mean can irritate you greatly, throwing you off balance. In order to deal with this, consider healthful practices heavily involving breathing, namely, running and yoga. There is a natural balance that takes place when you use these practices to calm yourself. Learning to incorporate breathing into your daily health regimen on a more conscious level will not only calm you, it will also support clear thinking and seeing better. You will notice the difference.

bits.t: Further good posture not only enhances one's personality but also plays an important role in improving health and confidence.

lucky.remedy: Prepare multi-grain rotis/bread and feed birds to grow financially.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: You and someone in power have a common goal -- might will be on your side.
